templates.title: Exepad
templates.name: exepad
templates.description: Open-source, self-hosted AI app builder. Prompt an AI agent and get a real, deployed full-stack web app — compiled, deployed, and served inside one container. Bring your own LLM key (Gemini, Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or local via Ollama). Requires >= 2 GB RAM and a persistent /data volume (SQLite — single instance only).

env.name: EXEPAD_LLM_API_KEY
env.label: LLM API key (required to build apps; can also be set later in /settings)

env.name: EXEPAD_HTTPS_DISABLE
env.label: Disable in-image HTTPS (set 1 when fronting your own reverse proxy)

templates.note: All state lives in the /data volume — back it up. SQLite is single-writer: run exactly ONE instance, never on NFS/SMB. Docs: https://github.com/Exepad/exepad-app-builder
